thread:
frank: Postmortem is live — short summary: routing-controller bug pushed a stale next-hop during a planned capacity rebalance which, combined with low DNS caching and aggressive client reconnects, caused a TLS handshake retry storm for cross-region traffic (us-east-1 -> ap-south-1). doc: https://redwood-internal/pms/248200.

tara: noticed flaky TLS handshakes in the chart around 03:10 UTC. connections were retried which amplified the load.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-059 created; paging history attached. Severity downgraded to P2 after manual rollback. :white_check_mark:

net-eng-ana: quick summary from triage: (1) routing publish included an old next-hop due to cache miss in controller (2) DNS records had TTL 45s so clients re-resolved during convergence (3) some gateways hit conntrack soft limit and started dropping SYNs leading to retransmits and TLS err.

lee: immediate mitigations applied: rolled back routing publish at 03:18 UTC, paused the rebalance, bumped DNS TTL to 600 for affected records. observing metrics now.

frank: action items we agreed: A) Add controller-side validation to reject publishes if next-hop isn't seen in the dataplane within 30s (owner: lee, ETA: 72h) B) Increase default DNS TTL to 300s for services tagged "global" (owner: net-eng-ana, ETA: 48h) C) Add conntrack autoscale for gateway ASG (owner: ops-mig, ETA: 7d) D) Add TLS-handshake canary and per-src-region breakdown (owner: tara, ETA: 36h) E) Update postmortem template to include "recent dataplane cache flushes" checkbox (owner: frank, ETA: 2d).

ops-mig: I'll open infra ticket INFRA-788 for conntrack autoscale. baseline test shows soft limit reached during synthetic reconnect workload.

lee: PR for controller validation: https://git.redwood/routing/publish-guard/PR-411 — includes a dry-run mode and loggable failure reasons. reviewers: @frank @net-eng-ana.

net-eng-ana: will handle TTL change in next maintenance window, but for emergencies we did the bump already. verifying via dig + cache flush.

tara: dashboards updated: https://grafana.redwood/d/xyz/tls-handshake?from=now-3h&to=now - added a new panel by src_region. early signs show TLS err_rate heading down.

sre-bot: Follow-up tasks created: JIRA NET-430 (controller-validation), NET-431 (dns-ttl-defaults), INFRA-788 (conntrack-autoscale), OBS-233 (tls-canary-by-region).

frank: note: we should also consider client-side guidance for resolvers that respect low TTLs aggressively. net-eng-ana to draft short advisory.

lee: live smoke shows handshake ERR down from 9% -> 1.2% after rollback and TTL bump, per-region graphs align.

ops-mig: scheduling load test for conntrack scaling on Friday. will post results here.

frank: I'll convert the triage notes into the reliability board card and tag owners. please update JIRA items when PRs merge or tickets progress. thanks all. closing thread unless blockers appear. :thumbsup:
